column1: # Declared tooling for Felix itself.
# Only what work on this harness actually reaches for, and only what is already
# installed. Written so the router can tell a declared tool from an undeclared
# one honestly; an empty stack.tsv would have reported every play entry as
# missing, which is a worse lie than saying nothing.
# Felix has no frontend, no database, no billing and nothing deployed, so the
# capability-gated half of the catalogue is deliberately absent rather than
# listed dormant.
# kind
marketplace

# Bundled into the Claude Code binary, so it carries no marketplace and appears
# in no plugin list. Its skills are live in every session regardless; declaring
# it is what lets a route name one honestly.
plugin
# A standalone skill under ~/.claude/skills, not a plugin: no marketplace and
# no entry in the plugin list. Declared so the orient route can name it and
# felix ready can find it, the same row another governed project carries. Its graph lives at
# graphify-out/ in the home checkout and is gitignored; maintenance.tsv says
# when it is behind the tree.
skill
